listings.name: Computer Mania Kolonnade Shopping Centre
listings.current_description: Computer Mania is a technology retailer selling laptops, desktop PCs, gaming equipment, PC components, consoles, software, and smart home devices, with a branch at Shop 7, Entrance 1, Kolonnade Shopping Centre in Montana, Pretoria East, and a "Reboot" pre-owned device programme.

listings.name: Cool Runners Logistics
listings.current_description: Cool Runners Logistics is a refrigerated transport and logistics company based in Daspoort, Pretoria, operating closed-body fridge trucks (4, 8 and 14 ton) delivering to customers across Gauteng and other provinces including the Free State, Mpumalanga, KwaZulu-Natal, Limpopo and North West.

listings.name: CorruPack
listings.current_description: CorruPack, based in Hennopspark, Centurion, supplies packaging solutions to industry and the public, including corrugated boxes, bubble wrap, moving boxes, pallet wrap, strapping and custom-printed packaging, acting as an intermediary between manufacturers and end-users to offer small-quantity orders at competitive prices.

listings.name: Cosmo Industrial
listings.current_description: Cosmo Industrial in Silverton supplies welding equipment and consumables, gas welding & cutting gear, power tools and safety equipment, and runs the in-house Cosmo Training Academy offering welding courses from basic to internationally certified levels, plus an accredited equipment service centre.

listings.name: CRC Clothing & Branding
listings.current_description: CRC Clothing & Branding is a custom apparel manufacturer in Rosslyn, Pretoria, specialising in sublimation-printed and embroidered clothing such as t-shirts, jerseys, hoodies and sports kits for corporate, sports and promotional use, with in-house design and sizes from XS to 8XL.

listings.name: Crux Pharmaceuticals
listings.current_description: Crux Pharmaceuticals is a South African pharmaceutical company established in 2007 that helps clients launch medicines, supplements, consumer health products, and medical devices in South Africa, offering services such as dossier registration, market and pricing analysis, distribution, and drug safety/pharmacovigilance.

listings.name: Dalein Agriplan (Pty) Ltd
listings.current_description: Dalein Agriplan is a Roodeplaat-based feed milling company, part of the Dalein Group, that designs and manufactures modular feed mills ranging from 5 to 30 tons per hour, along with raw material handling and processing facilities, for the African agricultural market.

listings.name: Dalein Voere
listings.current_description: Dalein Voere is a feed production company at Roodeplaat, part of the Dalein Group, that manufactures specialised diets and custom mixed feed for the pig, poultry, beef and dairy industries, supplying both its own 1000-sow piggery unit and the general public.

listings.name: Dawie Coetzer Attorneys
listings.current_description: Dawie Coetzer Attorneys is a law firm specializing in employment law and corporate commercial law, covering employment contracts, disciplinary hearings, CCMA and Labour Court matters, company formations, shareholder agreements, and commercial litigation, with an office in Boardwalk Office Park, Faerie Glen.

listings.name: Debt Success
listings.current_description: Debt Success is an Eloffsdal-based debt counselling and debt review service that negotiates with creditors on clients' behalf under the National Credit Act, consolidating multiple debts into a single monthly repayment plan; the practice is associated with debt counsellor Sulette Naude.

listings.name: DECOTEQ
listings.current_description: DECOTEQ manufactures EPS (expanded polystyrene) architectural mouldings and cladding, including its DECOCLAD decorative wall cladding panels and DECOTRIM exterior trim range (crown mouldings, window trims, sills and pillar caps), for residential and commercial building facades. The company has operated since 2014.

listings.name: Diep in die Berg Conference & Function Venue
listings.current_description: Diep in die Berg is a conference, function and wedding venue with an on-site restaurant on the slopes of the Bronberg mountain range in Wapadrand, Pretoria, featuring landscaped gardens, water features, indoor and outdoor fireplaces, and seven fully equipped conference venues.

listings.name: Digitize
listings.current_description: Digitize (Digitize Hub) is a Centurion-based provider of an AI-powered business operations platform called Digitize OS, combining CRM, project management, client portals, AI, and automation tools, and also offering website and dashboard development, business systems implementation, and free AI business audits.

listings.name: Dihlase Consulting Engineers
listings.current_description: Dihlase Consulting Engineers is a multidisciplinary consulting engineering practice offering electrical, mechanical and electronic engineering services, including facilities and project management, energy management and ICT engineering. The firm is a CESA member with ISO 9001 certification and offices across five provinces.

listings.name: DISTELL
listings.current_description: A production site of Distell, formerly one of Africa's leading producers of spirits, wine, cider and ready-to-drink beverages with brands including Amarula, Klipdrift, Savanna and Nederburg. Distell was acquired by Heineken in 2023 and merged into the new Heineken Beverages business.

listings.name: Ditsong Museum of Military History
listings.current_description: The Ditsong Museum of Military History in Saxonwold, Johannesburg, opened in 1947 as the South African National War Museum and preserves the history of military conflicts involving South Africans, also serving as a hub for veterans' organisations and military history societies.

listings.name: Doppio Zero Hazelwood
listings.current_description: Doppio Zero Hazelwood is a Mediterranean-inspired restaurant and bakery in Village Walk, Hazelwood, known for its wood-fired oven and fresh baked goods, dishes such as avocado toast and eggs benedict, and a cosy space with a fireplace and pet-friendly outdoor seating.

listings.name: Dries du Plessis Signs & Laser cutting
listings.current_description: Dries du Plessis Signs & Laser Cutting (trading as DuP Projects) is a Wonderboom South signage business with 26 years of industry experience, offering laser and CNC cutting, digital printing, banners, 3D lettering, chromadek signage, plexiglass display cases and custom trophies.

listings.name: DWH Construction
listings.current_description: DWH Construction is a Pretoria building contractor founded in 1998 by Dana and Willem Herholdt, offering turnkey construction and restoration services including new housing, alterations, plumbing and project management across Centurion, Pretoria and Midrand. The company is registered with the NHBRC.

listings.name: E Sun SA
listings.current_description: E Sun SA is a solar solutions company established in 2006 in a small Centurion warehouse, now one of Southern Africa's fastest-growing solar providers, distributing, installing and maintaining solar components for residential and commercial customers from its Pretoria East head office.

listings.name: Eagle Self Storage
listings.current_description: Eagle Self Storage, operating since 2000, offers self-storage units ranging from 3x3m to 6x6m, plus metal shipping containers and caravan storage, for households and businesses in Pretoria North. The facility features 24-hour CCTV monitoring, armed response security and allows customer-supplied locks.

listings.name: Eco Plant Pack (Pty) Ltd
listings.current_description: Eco Plant Pack (Pty) Ltd is a Rosslyn, Akasia based supplier of sustainable, eco-friendly packaging for the floristry and plant industries, including kraft paper wraps, drop-in sleeves, pot covers, carry bags, boxes and BOPP silk wraps made from FSC-approved kraft materials.

listings.name: EKM Exports
listings.current_description: EKM Exports is a South African export company founded in 1999, based in Hazeldean, specialising in the production, procurement and export of fresh produce including citrus, grapes, cherries and apples, with its premium citrus shipped to markets in the Far East.

listings.name: Elliott Attorneys Incorporated
listings.current_description: Elliott Attorneys Incorporated is a general practice law firm in Garsfontein, Pretoria, handling family law and divorce, civil litigation, debt collection, labour law (CCMA and Labour Court), contract law, evictions, sequestrations, antenuptial contracts, and company registration (CIPC), with consultations by appointment.

listings.name: Emeris - Pretoria Campus
listings.current_description: Emeris - Pretoria Campus is a private higher education institution in Lynnwood Glen, formed from the merger of The IIE's Varsity College, IIE MSA, Vega and the School of Hospitality and Service Management, registered under the Higher Education Act of 1997.

listings.name: Envestpro Pretoria
listings.current_description: Envestpro Pretoria is a financial planning and investment advisory practice, part of the Envestpro network (a Liberty Life entrepreneurial division), offering wills and estate planning, retirement and investment planning, family protection and medical cover, and corporate benefits from its Erasmuskloof office.

listings.name: ET IT Solutions
listings.current_description: ET IT Solutions is an IT and telecommunications company based in Eersterust, Pretoria, operating since 2012 and offering voice systems (3CX, Yealink), business fibre/wireless/LTE connectivity, cloud services (Office 365, hosted PBX) and security services including CCTV, biometrics and firewalls.

listings.name: EXZA
listings.current_description: EXZA ICT Services is a Kameeldrif East-based ICT company offering fibre installation, solar installation, communication tower installation, wireless connectivity and cloud services, along with project management, for residential and commercial clients. The company states it has completed over 3,000 projects.

listings.name: Fortuna Foods
listings.current_description: Fortuna Foods is a Centurion-based supplier of fresh speciality vegetables and herbs, including garlic, ginger, chillies and turmeric, along with related products like pickles and salsa verde, sourced from its own network of farms for the retail, food and hospitality trade.

listings.name: GBM Group of Companies - Registered Accountants
listings.current_description: GBM Group of Companies is a chartered accounting and auditing firm established in 1992, registered with the South African Institute of Chartered Accountants and the Independent Regulatory Board for Auditors, offering tax, bookkeeping and payroll services from its Ashley Gardens offices.

listings.name: Genlife Financial Services
listings.current_description: Genlife Financial Services is a funeral group-scheme insurance provider based in Boardwalk Manor, Faerie Glen, arranging group funeral cover for trade unions, employers, church groups and funeral homes as a Safrican binder holder with agreements including Sanlam and King Price Insurance.

listings.name: Gimi Access
listings.current_description: Gimi Access manufactures, supplies and installs Tactile Ground Surface Indicator paving for the visually impaired, and is the only South African company to handle all three in-house, also offering accessible street furniture, concrete elements and built-environment training for municipalities and contractors.

listings.name: Global Visa House
listings.current_description: Global Visa House is a Centurion-based visa and travel agency with more than 8 years' experience, having processed over 5,000 non-immigrant visa applications for tourism, business, study and medical travel, and also arranges air tickets, hotel bookings and travel packages.

listings.name: HDS Waltloo Cut & Edge
listings.current_description: HDS Waltloo Cut & Edge is a branch of the HDS Cut & Edge Group, the largest board cut-and-edge distributor in Sub-Saharan Africa, supplying raw MDF, chipboard, veneered, melamine-faced and high-gloss boards cut and edged to size, along with general hardware.

listings.name: Inry Pale And Top Thatch
listings.current_description: Inry Pale and Top Thatch is a thatching contractor that has operated since 1989, specialising in thatch roof installations and repairs and supplying thatching materials such as grass, cape reed, timber poles, laths and droppers, with exports to Namibia and Angola.

listings.name: International Race Supplies
listings.current_description: A motorsport equipment supplier in Pierre van Ryneveld Park, the sole South African and sub-Saharan distributor for several UK racing brands covering brake systems, braided brake hoses, oil control systems, fire suppression and racing harnesses, serving motorsport teams and defence industries.

listings.name: Jansen van Rensburg and Partners Inc
listings.current_description: Jansen van Rensburg and Partners Inc (JVR Inc) is a law firm in Clubview, Centurion, established in 2013, offering commercial and corporate law, family law, divorce and maintenance, labour law, debt collection, wills and trusts, and business rescue and liquidation services.

listings.name: Klagsbrun Edelstein Bosman Du Plessis Inc.
listings.current_description: Klagsbrun Edelstein Bosman Du Plessis Inc. is a Pretoria law firm with more than 50 years of history, offering corporate, commercial, tax, litigation, property, and estate law services from its Nieuw Muckleneuk office with a team of around 22 legal professionals.

listings.name: La Montagne Day Spa & Beauty Salon
listings.current_description: La Montagne Day Spa & Beauty Salon in La Montagne offers half and full day spa packages including massages, facials, aromatherapy and hair and nail treatments. Its venue also hosts events such as corporate team-building days, pamper parties and kitchen teas.

listings.name: Lancet Laboratories - Wilgers Hospital Medical Centre (Depot)
listings.current_description: Lancet Laboratories - Wilgers Hospital Medical Centre (Depot) is a pathology and diagnostic laboratory depot inside Wilgers Hospital Medical Centre, part of the wider Lancet Laboratories network of over 100 reference laboratories and 250 branches across more than 14 African countries.

listings.name: Leita Steel (Pty) Ltd
listings.current_description: A structural steel fabricator in Waltloo operating since 1968, providing project management, design, detailing, fabrication, erection and painting of structural steelwork for factories, warehouses, shopping centres, mine structures and power stations, with a production capacity of 8,000 tonnes per year.

listings.name: Magtran (Pty) Ltd
listings.current_description: Magtran (Pty) Ltd supplies transformers, inductors, coils and magnetic-related products to a range of industries from Hennopspark, where it has operated since moving to its current premises in the early 1980s and built a reputation for quality workmanship and customer service.

listings.name: MARIO MOTORS AND SPARE PARTS
listings.current_description: Mario Motors and Spare Parts opened in 2021 at its Mayville address, specializing in stripping vehicles for parts as well as buying and selling used cars, batteries and spares, with the aim of bringing affordable, personal-touch automotive service to Pretoria motorists.

listings.name: MaxCool Cooling Solutions (PTY) Ltd
listings.current_description: MaxCool Cooling Solutions has operated as part of the Airtrax Group since 1995, designing, supplying and installing industrial cooling and ventilation equipment such as mobile evaporative coolers and HVLS fans, with maintenance, servicing and short- and long-term cooler rentals also available.

listings.name: Maxmo Campers
listings.current_description: Maxmo Campers builds camper vans in Waltloo across full-size, multi-purpose and mini camper segments, built on bases including Fiat and Mercedes-Benz with a choice of short or long wheelbase and 2x4, 4x4 or 4-motion drivetrains; factory visits are by appointment only.

listings.name: MetQ Mineral Process Equipment
listings.current_description: MetQ designs and manufactures mineral processing equipment such as hydrocyclones, spirals, hydrosizers and screen media from its Rosslyn facility, drawing on more than 40 years of experience in particle sizing and gravity concentration for the mining, food and water treatment industries.

listings.name: MTN Store - Wonderpark Shopping Centre
listings.current_description: This MTN Store at Wonderpark Shopping Centre in Karenpark, Akasia offers the full range of mobile phones, SIM cards, prepaid and postpaid plans, data bundles and fibre internet along with business connectivity solutions, and features wheelchair-accessible entrances, parking and electronic-waste recycling.

listings.name: MTP Security Services
listings.current_description: MTP Security Services is a 100% Black-owned security company offering armed and unarmed guarding, residential and commercial access control, roaming patrols and asset protection, plus event security and escort services, serving clients in the retail, commercial, industrial, private and education sectors.

listings.name: Noakalesse Business Solutions
listings.current_description: Noakalesse Business Solutions is a firm of Chartered Accountants and tax practitioners in Waterkloof Glen offering business planning, business case evaluations and project and structured finance advisory services, with experience on Auditor-General audits and Treasury Regulations, PFMA and GRAP compliance work.

listings.name: Oasis Water Meyerspark
listings.current_description: This Meyerspark branch of Oasis Water sells purified drinking water that goes through a 6-step purification process reducing total dissolved solids to under 20, well below the 150-plus TDS typical of municipal tap water, alongside bottled water, refills and dispenser rental.
